title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the recent hybrid attacks and instrumentalisation of migrants in Ceuta and the need for a coordinated response to protect the EU’s external borders
part_text: 13. Stresses the urgent need to ensure the swift and effective return of all those who have no right to remain in the EU, in full compliance with EU and international law; urges Spain and Morocco to accelerate their cooperation on returns and readmission of all irregular migrants who arrived during the mass illegal crossing of 29-31 July 2026;
